payload.definition_x: A piece of furniture with shelves used to hold books.

items.definition: A compact furnishing placed beside a bed for keeping a lamp, alarm, or personal items.
A tall freestanding storage piece with doors and a hanging rail for clothing.
A bedroom storage piece with several drawers for folded clothing and personal belongings.
A low dining-room furnishing with doors or drawers, often used for serving dishes and storing tableware.
A dining-room furnishing combining a lower storage section with an upper display area or shelves.
A glass-fronted furnishing used to exhibit collectibles, dishes, or other valued objects.
A sturdy lidded furnishing used to store clothing, linens, or household possessions.
A compact work furnishing with a hinged surface that folds down and compartments for papers.
A work surface supported by legs, often including drawers for writing materials or office equipment.
A flat-topped furnishing supported by legs, used for meals, work, or placing objects.
A seat designed for one person, typically with a back and four legs.
A long upholstered seat designed to accommodate several people.
A frame and mattress designed to support a person during sleep.
A long seat, often without a back, designed for several people.
A simple seat, usually without arms or a back, supported by legs.
A low living-room surface placed in front of seating for drinks, books, or decorations.
An upholstered seat whose back tilts backward and footrest rises for comfortable lounging.
A seat mounted on curved runners that allow gentle back-and-forth motion.
A padded, low furnishing used as a footrest or occasional extra seat.
A panel fixed at the head of a sleeping frame, often decorative or supportive.
